svg.text: For the Open Innovation theme, Constellation turns your day's conversations into a star map: each person you talked
to becomes a star, brighter for longer calls, and the stars join in the order you spoke, so the shape of your social
day appears behind the time. When someone close drifts away their star fades and the face suggests saying hi.
Always-on keeps the constellation as grey points and lines on true black.
368 × 448 rectangular OLED · text ≥ 21 px · icons ≥ 25 px · always-on on true black · all names fictional, no logos · Designed by Amritha S
